title: Grover Zampa Vineyards enters imported spirits and wines segment, targets international brands
summary: The move comes amid changes in import duties following trade agreements. Under the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement, which came into force on July 15, 2026, basic customs duty on Scotch whisky and gin was reduced from 150 per cent to 75 per cent, with a further reduction to 40 per cent planned over 10 years. The India-EU trade agreement is also expected to bring duty reductions for European spirits.
